questions.stem: Simplify the Boolean expression using a 2x2 Karnaugh map: A'B' + AB + ABC
questions.solution:
The Karnaugh map for the given expression is as follows:

   |    | A' B'
--+---+-----
 A'| 1  | 0  
--+---+-----
 AB| 1  | 1  
--+---+-----
 ABC| 0  | 1  

Group the 1s in the map to form a largest possible grouping:

   |    | A' B'
--+---+-----
 A'| 1  |     
--+---+-----
 AB| 1  | 1  
--+---+-----
 ABC|

The largest grouping is 2 cells, which gives us the simplified expression A'B'.
questions.explanation: The Karnaugh map helps to visualize and simplify Boolean expressions by grouping similar terms. In this case, grouping A'B' and AB results in a simplified form of A'B'.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is not grouping the 1s correctly or attempting to group more than 4 cells at once. Remember that Karnaugh maps for up to 3 variables allow grouping of up to 4 adjacent cells.
